findings.what: 182 near-identical rows with no recommended pick; too many options to choose from
Every row repeats the same labels (ההחיסכון, ההפקדה, מניות, מט"ח, 3 שנים, 5 שנים), so you re-read them each time to spot the difference
Fees only shown as small percents, never in shekels, so the differences feel like nothing
The ring's colours are only explained by small dots on the side, so I had to guess what they mean
Stock shares above 100% (101%, 103%) look like a mistake
Sorted by company and then by fee, not by cheapest overall, so comparing S&P tracks means jumping around
No next step: nothing tells me how to actually move into the track
Not clear whether these 'גמל' tracks are the pension HR signed me up for
